description:
Get full details for a single order by Schwab order ID.

Returns the same one-line markdown format as get_brokerage_orders, with
the average fill price computed across all executionLegs:

  - **<orderId>** [<status>] <orderType> | <legs> | Price: $X @ $avg_fill |
    Filled: <qty> | <enteredTime>

Use this when you already have an orderId (e.g., from
get_brokerage_orders or from a fill notification) and want a single
crisp row rather than the full history list.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

order_id.description: The Schwab order ID as returned by get_brokerage_orders.

name: schwab_get_brokerage_order
title: Order details
